population: Customer-confirmed completed bookings; cancellation is a predictor, not a negative completion label.

definitions.completed_jobs_before: Count of customer-confirmed completed bookings in the worker's current source cohort before snapshot capture; ignore aggregate seed counters.
definitions.cancellation_rate_before: Worker-cancelled bookings / (confirmed completions + worker cancellations). Exclude customer cancellations, pending work and rejections.
definitions.late_rate_before: Confirmed completions reported after deadline / confirmed completions with a deadline and completion report.
definitions.avg_response_minutes_before: Mean nonnegative minutes from booking creation to first accepted/rejected event.
definitions.avg_rating_before: Mean recorded reviews of confirmed completions, across all categories, in the same source cohort.
definitions.complaint_rate_before: Upheld complaints / (confirmed completions + worker cancellations), excluding bookings with pending complaints. Missing denominator is null.

missing: Unknown rates and ratings are null. The model fits median imputation on training data only.
snapshot: Capture at booking creation before outcomes; training consumes that immutable snapshot, never rebuilt current profiles.
category_scoring: Use category-specific confirmed counts, rating, complaint evidence; reliability features remain worker-wide. Experience is self-reported and worker-wide.
